description: Records, driving habits, charging mix and monthly costs, with a comparison against a combustion car.

panels.description: Savings and avoided CO₂ are estimated against a combustion-engine car using the fuel price and consumption variables. Charges without a recorded cost are valued at the default price per kWh (0 by default).

targets.rawSql:
WITH dr AS (
  SELECT sum(d.distance) AS km, count(*) AS n, sum(d.duration_min) AS mins, sum((d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency) AS kwh_used
  FROM drives d JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
), ch AS (
  SELECT sum(greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used)) AS kwh, sum(COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) * $default_kwh_price)) AS cost
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT convert_km(dr.km::numeric, '$length_unit')                         AS "distance_$length_unit",
       dr.n                                                    AS "Drives",
       dr.mins * 60                                            AS "Time driving",
       ch.kwh                                                  AS "Energy charged",
       ch.cost                                                 AS "Charging cost",
       dr.km * $ice_consumption / 100 * $fuel_price - ch.cost  AS "Saved vs. combustion-engine car",
       dr.km * $ice_consumption / 100 * 2.31                   AS "Tailpipe CO₂ avoided",
       dr.kwh_used * 1000 / NULLIF(convert_km(dr.km::numeric, '$length_unit'), 0) AS "consumption_$length_unit"
FROM dr, ch

panels.title: Records in the selected time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH proc AS (
  SELECT cp.*, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) AS kwh, COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) * $default_kwh_price) AS total_cost
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
), ct AS (
  -- one index lookup per charging process (charges_charging_process_id_index)
  SELECT p.id, x.phases, x.tesla, x.max_kw
  FROM proc p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT NULLIF(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ch.charger_phases), 0) AS phases,
           bool_or(ch.fast_charger_brand = 'Tesla') AS tesla,
           max(ch.charger_power) AS max_kw
    FROM charges ch
    WHERE ch.charging_process_id = p.id
  ) x
)
SELECT rec AS "Record", val AS "Value", day AS "Date", place AS "Where"
FROM (
(SELECT 1 AS ord, '🛣️ Longest drive'::text AS rec, (round(convert_km(d.distance::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.distance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 2 AS ord, '⏱️ Longest time behind the wheel'::text AS rec, ((d.duration_min / 60) || ' h ' || lpad((d.duration_min % 60)::text, 2, '0') || ' min')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.duration_min DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 3 AS ord, '📅 Most distance in one day'::text AS rec, (round(convert_km(sum(d.distance)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit in ' || count(*) || CASE WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN ' drive' ELSE ' drives' END)::text AS val, (min(to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')))::text AS day, (array_to_string((array_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))[1:4], ', '))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY (timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')::date
    ORDER BY sum(d.distance) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 4 AS ord, '🏎️ Top speed'::text AS rec, (round(convert_km(d.speed_max::numeric, '$length_unit')) || CASE '$length_unit' WHEN 'km' THEN ' km/h' ELSE ' mph' END)::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.speed_max DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 5 AS ord, '⚡ Max power'::text AS rec, (d.power_max || ' kW')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.power_max DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 6 AS ord, '🔋 Max regen'::text AS rec, (abs(d.power_min) || ' kW')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.power_min ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 7 AS ord, '🌱 Most efficient drive (20 km / 12 mi or longer)'::text AS rec, (round(((d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency * 1000 / convert_km(d.distance::numeric, '$length_unit'))::numeric) || ' Wh/$length_unit')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND d.distance >= 20 AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km > d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km
    ORDER BY (d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency / d.distance ASC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 8 AS ord, '🥶 Coldest drive'::text AS rec, (round(convert_celsius(d.outside_temp_avg, '$temp_unit'), 1) || ' °$temp_unit')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND d.distance >= 5
    ORDER BY d.outside_temp_avg ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 9 AS ord, '🥵 Hottest drive'::text AS rec, (round(convert_celsius(d.outside_temp_avg, '$temp_unit'), 1) || ' °$temp_unit')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', d.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (concat_ws(' → ', COALESCE(sa.city, sa.county, sa.name), COALESCE(ea.city, ea.county, ea.name)))::text AS place
    FROM drives d
    JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses sa ON sa.id = d.start_address_id
    LEFT JOIN addresses ea ON ea.id = d.end_address_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND d.distance >= 5
    ORDER BY d.outside_temp_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 10 AS ord, '🚀 Fastest charge'::text AS rec, (ct.max_kw || ' kW')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', cp.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.city, a.county, split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)))::text AS place
    FROM ct JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = ct.id
    LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
    LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
    WHERE true
    ORDER BY ct.max_kw DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 11 AS ord, '🔌 Most energy in one charge'::text AS rec, (round(cp.charge_energy_added, 1) || ' kWh')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', cp.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.city, a.county, split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)))::text AS place
    FROM charging_processes cp
    LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
    LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
    WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cp.charge_energy_added DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 12 AS ord, '💸 Most expensive charge'::text AS rec, (to_char(cp.cost, 'FM999990.00'))::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', cp.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.city, a.county, split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)))::text AS place
    FROM charging_processes cp
    LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
    LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
    WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND cp.cost IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cp.cost DESC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 13 AS ord, '🤑 Cheapest paid charge per kWh (≥ 5 kWh)'::text AS rec, (to_char(cp.cost / greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used), 'FM0.000') || ' / kWh')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', cp.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.city, a.county, split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)))::text AS place
    FROM charging_processes cp
    LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
    LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
    WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND cp.cost > 0 AND greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) >= 5
    ORDER BY cp.cost / greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) ASC LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT 14 AS ord, '🪫 Lowest battery when plugging in'::text AS rec, (cp.start_battery_level || ' %')::text AS val, (to_char((timezone('UTC', cp.start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::text AS day, (COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.city, a.county, split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)))::text AS place
    FROM charging_processes cp
    LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
    LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
    WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cp.start_battery_level ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
) r
WHERE val IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: When do you leave?
panels.description: Number of drives by departure hour.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT extract(hour FROM (timezone('UTC', start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int AS h
  FROM drives
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT lpad(g::text, 2, '0') || 'h' AS "Hour",
       count(d.h)                  AS "Drives"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) g
LEFT JOIN d ON d.h = g
GROUP BY g
ORDER BY g

panels.title: Which days do you drive the most?

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT extract(isodow FROM (timezone('UTC', start_date) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int AS dow, distance
  FROM drives
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT (ARRAY['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'])[g] AS "Day",
       convert_km(COALESCE(sum(d.distance), 0)::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "distance_$length_unit"
FROM generate_series(1, 7) g
LEFT JOIN d ON d.dow = g
GROUP BY g
ORDER BY g

panels.title: Consumption vs. outside temperature
panels.description: Net consumption by 5° buckets of average outside temperature (buckets with at least 20 km).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT (floor(convert_celsius(d.outside_temp_avg, '$temp_unit') / 5) * 5)::int AS b,
         d.distance, (d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency AS kwh
  FROM drives d JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.distance >= 1 AND d.outside_temp_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b || ' to ' || (b + 5) || ' °$temp_unit'                          AS "Outside temperature",
       sum(kwh) * 1000 / convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit')        AS "consumption_$length_unit"
FROM d
GROUP BY b
HAVING sum(distance) >= 20
ORDER BY b

panels.title: Consumption vs. average speed
panels.description: Net consumption by average speed of the drive (buckets with at least 20 km).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT LEAST(floor(convert_km(d.distance::numeric, '$length_unit') / (d.duration_min / 60.0) / 10) * 10, 140)::int AS b,
         d.distance, (d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency AS kwh
  FROM drives d JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.distance >= 1 AND d.duration_min > 0
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b = 140 THEN '140+' ELSE b || '–' || (b + 10) END || CASE '$length_unit' WHEN 'km' THEN ' km/h' ELSE ' mph' END AS "Average speed",
       sum(kwh) * 1000 / convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit')             AS "consumption_$length_unit"
FROM d
GROUP BY b
HAVING sum(distance) >= 20
ORDER BY b

panels.title: Where do you charge?
panels.description: Energy by charging type. AC charges inside a geofence show the geofence name (e.g. Home).

targets.rawSql:
WITH proc AS (
  SELECT cp.*, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) AS kwh, COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) * $default_kwh_price) AS total_cost
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
), ct AS (
  -- one index lookup per charging process (charges_charging_process_id_index)
  SELECT p.id, x.phases, x.tesla, x.max_kw
  FROM proc p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT NULLIF(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ch.charger_phases), 0) AS phases,
           bool_or(ch.fast_charger_brand = 'Tesla') AS tesla,
           max(ch.charger_power) AS max_kw
    FROM charges ch
    WHERE ch.charging_process_id = p.id
  ) x
), typed AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.kwh, p.total_cost, p.duration_min, ct.max_kw,
         CASE
           WHEN ct.phases IS NULL THEN
             CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.tesla, false) OR a.name ILIKE '%supercharger%' OR g.name ILIKE '%supercharger%'
                  THEN 'Supercharger' ELSE 'DC (other networks)' END
           WHEN g.name IS NOT NULL THEN g.name
           ELSE 'AC (outside geofences)'
         END AS kind,
         COALESCE(g.name, a.name, nullif(concat_ws(' ', a.road, a.house_number), ''), a.city, a.county,
                  split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)) AS place,
         COALESCE(a.city, a.county) AS city
  FROM proc p
  JOIN ct ON ct.id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = p.address_id
  LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = p.geofence_id
  WHERE p.kwh > 0.01
)
SELECT kind AS "Type", sum(kwh) AS "kWh"
FROM typed
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY 2 DESC

WITH proc AS (
  SELECT cp.*, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) AS kwh, COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) * $default_kwh_price) AS total_cost
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
), ct AS (
  -- one index lookup per charging process (charges_charging_process_id_index)
  SELECT p.id, x.phases, x.tesla, x.max_kw
  FROM proc p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT NULLIF(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ch.charger_phases), 0) AS phases,
           bool_or(ch.fast_charger_brand = 'Tesla') AS tesla,
           max(ch.charger_power) AS max_kw
    FROM charges ch
    WHERE ch.charging_process_id = p.id
  ) x
), typed AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.kwh, p.total_cost, p.duration_min, ct.max_kw,
         CASE
           WHEN ct.phases IS NULL THEN
             CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.tesla, false) OR a.name ILIKE '%supercharger%' OR g.name ILIKE '%supercharger%'
                  THEN 'Supercharger' ELSE 'DC (other networks)' END
           WHEN g.name IS NOT NULL THEN g.name
           ELSE 'AC (outside geofences)'
         END AS kind,
         COALESCE(g.name, a.name, nullif(concat_ws(' ', a.road, a.house_number), ''), a.city, a.county,
                  split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)) AS place,
         COALESCE(a.city, a.county) AS city
  FROM proc p
  JOIN ct ON ct.id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = p.address_id
  LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = p.geofence_id
  WHERE p.kwh > 0.01
)
SELECT kind                                   AS "Type",
       count(*)                               AS "Charges",
       sum(kwh)                               AS "Energy",
       sum(kwh) * 100 / sum(sum(kwh)) OVER () AS "Share",
       sum(total_cost)                        AS "Cost",
       sum(total_cost) / NULLIF(sum(kwh), 0)  AS "Cost / kWh",
       sum(duration_min) * 60                 AS "Time plugged in",
       max(max_kw)                            AS "Peak power"
FROM typed
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY 3 DESC

WITH proc AS (
  SELECT cp.*, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) AS kwh, COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) * $default_kwh_price) AS total_cost
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
), ct AS (
  -- one index lookup per charging process (charges_charging_process_id_index)
  SELECT p.id, x.phases, x.tesla, x.max_kw
  FROM proc p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT NULLIF(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ch.charger_phases), 0) AS phases,
           bool_or(ch.fast_charger_brand = 'Tesla') AS tesla,
           max(ch.charger_power) AS max_kw
    FROM charges ch
    WHERE ch.charging_process_id = p.id
  ) x
), typed AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.kwh, p.total_cost, p.duration_min, ct.max_kw,
         CASE
           WHEN ct.phases IS NULL THEN
             CASE WHEN COALESCE(ct.tesla, false) OR a.name ILIKE '%supercharger%' OR g.name ILIKE '%supercharger%'
                  THEN 'Supercharger' ELSE 'DC (other networks)' END
           WHEN g.name IS NOT NULL THEN g.name
           ELSE 'AC (outside geofences)'
         END AS kind,
         COALESCE(g.name, a.name, nullif(concat_ws(' ', a.road, a.house_number), ''), a.city, a.county,
                  split_part(a.display_name, ',', 1)) AS place,
         COALESCE(a.city, a.county) AS city
  FROM proc p
  JOIN ct ON ct.id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = p.address_id
  LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = p.geofence_id
  WHERE p.kwh > 0.01
)
SELECT place                                 AS "Location",
       city                                  AS "City",
       kind                                  AS "Type",
       count(*)                              AS "Charges",
       sum(kwh)                              AS "Energy",
       sum(total_cost)                       AS "Cost",
       sum(total_cost) / NULLIF(sum(kwh), 0) AS "Cost / kWh",
       max(max_kw)                           AS "Peak power"
FROM typed
GROUP BY place, city, kind
ORDER BY 5 DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Battery level when plugging in / unplugging

targets.rawSql:
WITH cp AS (
  SELECT start_battery_level, end_battery_level
  FROM charging_processes
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL
), lv AS (
  SELECT LEAST(floor(start_battery_level / 10.0) * 10, 90)::int AS b, 'start' AS k FROM cp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LEAST(floor(end_battery_level / 10.0) * 10, 90)::int, 'end' FROM cp
)
SELECT g || '–' || (g + 10) || ' %'            AS "Battery level",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lv.k = 'start')  AS "When plugging in",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lv.k = 'end')    AS "When unplugging"
FROM generate_series(0, 90, 10) g
LEFT JOIN lv ON lv.b = g
GROUP BY g
ORDER BY g

panels.title: Distance and charging cost per month

targets.rawSql:
WITH dm AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', d.start_date), '$__timezone') AS month,
         sum(d.distance) AS km, count(*) AS drives, sum((d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km - d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km) * c.efficiency) AS kwh_used
  FROM drives d JOIN cars c ON c.id = d.car_id
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
), cm AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', cp.start_date), '$__timezone') AS month,
         sum(greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used)) AS kwh, sum(COALESCE(cp.cost, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) * $default_kwh_price)) AS cost
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(COALESCE(dm.month, cm.month) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone', 'YYYY-MM')   AS "Month",
       convert_km(COALESCE(dm.km, 0)::numeric, '$length_unit')                        AS "distance_$length_unit",
       COALESCE(dm.drives, 0)                                              AS "Drives",
       COALESCE(cm.kwh, 0)                                                 AS "Energy charged",
       COALESCE(cm.cost, 0)                                                AS "Charging cost",
       cm.cost * 100 / NULLIF(convert_km(dm.km::numeric, '$length_unit'), 0)          AS "cost_per_100_$length_unit",
       dm.kwh_used * 1000 / NULLIF(convert_km(dm.km::numeric, '$length_unit'), 0)     AS "consumption_$length_unit",
       COALESCE(dm.km, 0) * $ice_consumption / 100 * $fuel_price
         - COALESCE(cm.cost, 0)                                            AS "Saved vs. combustion-engine car"
FROM dm
FULL JOIN cm ON cm.month = dm.month
ORDER BY 1

list.name: car_id
list.query:
SELECT
    id as __value,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(id) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(name, ' - ', RIGHT(vin, 6)) ELSE COALESCE(name, CONCAT('VIN ', vin)) end as __text 
FROM cars
ORDER BY display_priority ASC, name ASC, vin ASC;
